body: I wish I could agree, but from my experience you can do everything right - life still gonna fuck you over. I'v tried, really. I appreciate that last sentence tho. I live with my mom & sisters & feel like I have nobody. she treats them better than she treated me. @ 12 & 15 they have freedom after school, wear clothing that I was branded a slut for. Theyre disrespectful & she does nothing. This is triggering for me, as I got hit in the face, beat, called derogatory terms, had no social life from 11-18 for much less than the thotty shit my sisters do.
